snippet.title: Gamers Assembly HE 2025 | Ancestral Players – Grand Final
snippet.description:
First Official tournament of Ancestral Players in a LAN ! My indie game was played among PUBG, Fall Guys, CS2 or LOL at Gamers Assembly Halloween Edition in November 2025. 

Commented by: Armada & Mirtonze 

25 participants - top 6 in this final 

top 1 - DOCKYZ
top 2 - Apocaliypse
top 3 - Shoko
top 4 - klusty
top 5 - Niivak
top 6 - Hemdal

Congrats!!

You can watch the full tournament here: https://www.twitch.tv/gamers_assembly/video/2613743617

The game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349430?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=gahe25
